official.deadline_note: Registration for the Becas PUCP contest ran 14 September to 9 October 2026 (no closing time published). The contest itself continues: Evaluacion de Potencial on 18 October 2026, finalist interviews on 8 November 2026, winners published in December 2026.
official.status_note: Registration closed on 9 October 2026; the selection process is under way with the written aptitude test on 18 October 2026, finalist interviews on 8 November 2026 and the publication of winners in December 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: 'Cobertura del 100% de derechos academicos. No cubre el derecho de matricula que se paga en la primera cuota de cada ciclo de estudios', with the footnote 'Con excepcion de los cursos retirados'.
benefits: Coverage of 100% of academic fees (derechos academicos) for the enrolled programme, excluding the matricula fee paid with the first instalment of each cycle and courses withdrawn from the curriculum

Six complementary bonuses: study materials for each regular cycle, English study at Idiomas Catolica as set by PUCP for language accreditation, mobility, food, accommodation for scholars from outside Lima (subject to assessment by the Consejo Directivo de Becas y Credito Educativo), and fees for the bachiller degree and professional title (subject to the same assessment)
Three insurance policies: accident cover, national oncological cover and educational-income insurance
Accompaniment programme from the Oficina de Becas with individual or group activities matched to scholars' interests and needs
Awarded for one academic year (two regular cycles), renewable annually to the end of the degree subject to faculty ranking
Only 14 scholarships per year, allocated strictly by faculty
eligibility: Be in the 5th year of secondary school in 2026 at any public or private school nationwide
Hold PUCP pre-admission by September 2026 through any admission process for the 2027-1 intake (March start)
Accredit high school achievement from 1st to 4th year of secondary with a constancia de excelencia academica escolar, based on accumulated academic merit
For Estudios Generales Ciencias, Estudios Generales Letras and Arquitectura: the certificate must show decimo superior standing
For Artes Escenicas, Arte y Diseno and Educacion: the certificate must show quinto superior standing
COAR college students must present a constancia de Alto Rendimiento Escolar instead
requirements: Register in the Becas PUCP contest between 14 September and 9 October 2026; registration is free of charge
Sit the Evaluacion de Potencial, a written in-person cognitive-aptitude test of about 90 minutes on the PUCP campus on 18 October 2026
Attend an in-person finalist interview of about 20 minutes on 8 November 2026 if shortlisted
Sign the scholarship acceptance letter, which details the programme guidelines, coverage and grounds for loss
For renewal: be within the upper half of the faculty at the end of the first year and within the upper third from the second year onward
documents: Constancia de excelencia academica escolar covering 1st to 4th year of secondary, showing decimo superior or quinto superior as applicable to the faculty
PUCP pre-admission documentation for the 2027-1 intake (obtained by September 2026)
For COAR students, a constancia de Alto Rendimiento Escolar
Signed scholarship acceptance letter once awarded, detailing guidelines, coverage and grounds for loss
selection_criteria: Evaluacion de Potencial: a written, in-person cognitive-aptitude test lasting about 90 minutes on the PUCP campus, held on 18 October 2026, to identify talent
Finalist in-person interview of about 20 minutes on 8 November 2026, open only to applicants who passed the aptitude test

Places are allocated by faculty: 5 for Estudios Generales Ciencias, 5 for Estudios Generales Letras, and 1 each for Arquitectura y Urbanismo, Arte y Diseno, Artes Escenicas and Educacion (14 in total)
coverage: 100% of academic fees for the enrolled programme, except the matricula fee paid with the first instalment of each cycle and courses withdrawn from the curriculum
Study-materials bonus for each regular academic cycle
English-language study at Idiomas Catolica as set by PUCP for language accreditation
Accommodation (alojamiento) for scholars from outside Lima, subject to assessment by the Consejo Directivo de Becas y Credito Educativo
Fees for obtaining the bachiller degree and the professional title, subject to the same assessment
Three insurance policies: accident cover, national cancer cover and educational-income insurance
application_method: Register online through the Becas PUCP contest portal between 14 September and 9 October 2026 at no cost
Sit the Evaluacion de Potencial aptitude test on the PUCP campus on Sunday 18 October 2026
Only applicants who pass the aptitude evaluation proceed to the finalist interviews on 8 November 2026
official.application_route: Secure PUCP pre-admission for the 2027-1 intake, register free in the Becas PUCP contest (14 September - 9 October 2026), then sit the Evaluacion de Potencial and, if shortlisted, the finalist interview.
official.study_mode: Full-time undergraduate degree study at PUCP
official.citizenship_residency: Students concluding the 5th year of secondary school in 2026 at a public or private school anywhere in Peru
official.international_eligibility: Not an international scholarship - it is aimed at Peruvian school-leavers entering PUCP for the 2027-1 intake
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Places are allocated strictly by faculty: 5 Estudios Generales Ciencias, 5 Estudios Generales Letras, 1 each for Arquitectura y Urbanismo, Arte y Disño, Artes Escenicas and Educacion; the number of scholarships is updated annually
official.duration: One academic year (two regular cycles), renewable annually up to the end of the degree while faculty-ranking conditions are met
official.description: The Beca R.P. Jorge Dintilhac SS.CC. supports young people finishing secondary school in 2026 with excellent school performance, covering 100% of academic fees plus six complementary bonuses and three insurance policies, with only 14 scholarships awarded each year and allocated by faculty under PUCP's general scholarship regulations.

applicant_utility.summary: With only 14 places split by faculty, this is one of Peru's most competitive school-leaver scholarships: you need PUCP pre-admission by September 2026 plus a school certificate proving decimo superior ( Ciencias, Letras, Arquitectura) or quinto superior (Artes Escenicas, Arte y Disño, Educacion) standing. Coverage is broad but not total - the matricula fee paid with the first instalment of every cycle stays on you, and the bonus values are set annually by the Oficina de Becas, so never quote a peso figure from memory. Renewal depends on staying in the upper half of your faculty in year one and the upper third afterwards, so the award is earned again every year.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-ranked Peruvian school-leavers from low-income families who have already secured PUCP pre-admission for the March 2027 intake and can document top-tenth or top-fifth secondary standing.
application_readiness_checklist: Request the constancia de excelencia academica from your school now - it must cover 1st to 4th year of secondary and state decimo or quinto superior, and schools are slow in October

Confirm which faculty your intended career belongs to, because that determines whether you need decimo superior (Ciencias, Letras, Arquitectura) or quinto superior (Artes Escenicas, Arte y Diseño, Educacion)
COAR students: request the constancia de Alto Rendimiento Escolar instead of the excellence certificate
Complete PUCP pre-admission by September 2026 - the scholarship cannot proceed without it
Register in the contest portal before 9 October 2026 (free) and keep the confirmation
Prepare for the 90-minute written Evaluacion de Potencial on 18 October 2026 and a 20-minute interview on 8 November 2026 - both in person on campus
common_rejection_risks: Missing the faculty-specific cut: decimo superior for Ciencias, Letras and Arquitectura, quinto superior for Artes Escenicas, Arte y Diseño and Educacion
A certificate that does not state accumulated merit across 1st to 4th year of secondary
Lacking PUCP pre-admission by September 2026, which is a hard requirement regardless of school performance
Assuming the matricula fee is covered - it is explicitly excluded from the 100% academic-fee coverage
Letting renewal slide: falling out of the upper half of the faculty in year one, or the upper third later, ends the scholarship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The matricula fee payable with the first instalment of each study cycle; any courses withdrawn from the curriculum; and any bonus shortfalls, since bonus amounts and delivery are set annually by the Oficina de Becas.
document_audit: The constancia de excelencia academica is the make-or-break document - verify it explicitly says decimo superior or quinto superior as your faculty requires
COAR students follow a different certificate route (Alto Rendimiento Escolar); using the standard one causes rejection
Insurance enrolment depends on the provider's assessment, and the accommodation and degree-fee benefits on the Consejo Directivo's annual assessment - neither is automatic
alerts: Only 14 scholarships exist and the number is updated annually - competition is extreme, so treat the interview as the real final
Registration closed on 9 October 2026; the process continues with the test on 18 October and interviews on 8 November, with winners in December 2026
The scholarship is renewable, not guaranteed: faculty ranking is re-checked every year
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Free online registration in the Becas PUCP contest, then the in-person Evaluacion de Potencial, an in-person finalist interview for those who pass, and publication of winners in December 2026.
